req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of retrieving a player by ID from the API. It includes a positive test to ensure correct retrieval, a negative test to handle non-existent IDs, and a boundary test to check the behavior with an invalid UUID format. These tests ensure the API behaves correctly under normal, erroneous, and edge-case conditions.

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_valid_id
preconditions: Player with ID 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c' exists in the database.
expected: Response contains player data for Lionel Messi
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {
    "id": "acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c",
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_nonexistent_id
preconditions: Player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_invalid_id_format
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/invalid-uuid-format')
assert response.status_code == 422
